Drawback: Activation Condition.name: Drawback: Activation Condition
Drawback: Activation Condition.description:
🔑 Your Quirk only works when a condition is met: touch, eye contact, a spoken trigger, an answer from the target, a gesture or the right light.

⚠️ Anyone who learns your condition can deny it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hitoshi Shinso (Brainwashing), Midnight (Somnambulist).
Drawback: Activation Condition.traitNarrativeEffects: The Quirk fires only when a condition is met, matching the family (touch for contact, sight for gaze, a reply for voice Quirks) unless the player names another; once set, it stays. Anyone who learns it can deny it: gloves, blindfolds, silence, distance or darkness shut the Quirk down without touching the user. Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): the condition tightens (firmer contact, a clearer look, a longer answer); near misses that once worked now fail. Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; the condition must be fully met and held for the whole use; any use beyond light ends the moment it breaks. Quirk Strain 100: the Quirk stops answering its condition and gives out until Strain is below 60; the user's head pounds. Signs fade as Strain drops below each threshold. Ordinary life: touch users wear gloves, voice users pick words carefully and people avoid answering them, sight users wear tinted glasses. Quirkless: no effect.
